newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco court halves jail term for pregnant Briton.
newsitem.headline: Morocco court halves jail term for pregnant Briton.

text.p: A Moroccan court on Thursday cut to two and a half years jail terms imposed on two British women, including a pregnant teenager, on drug charges.
The Casablanca appeal court issued its verdict in the absence of hairdresser Sally Louise Griffiths, 17, said by her lawyer to be pregnant, and barmaid Claire Louise Martin, 28.
Both women come from Harwich, southeast England and were sentenced to five years imprisonment in August. The court maintained a 5,000 dirhams ($581) fine on each.
Their lawyer would not comment on the court's decision.
